# GenAI Career Intelligence System

> Evidence-graded knowledge and guidance for GenAI careers, across the whole lifecycle: which roles exist, where their work sits and which are best; what each role needs (every concept, tool and soft skill, tiered and evidence-tagged); how to prove it, get seen, pass the interview loop, evaluate and negotiate an offer and start well; tracks for transitions, India-based remote work, visas, independent practice and governance careers; and the 75 research sessions behind it all. Every empirical claim carries an EGP-1.0 grade (A/B measured, C small-sample or vendor, D judgement, M model output, P practice-curated) and a date.

How to use this repository:

- Start at career/README.md (Start Here) or a stage README; each stage README links its guides and its graded research findings.
- Facts live once: machine-readable sources of truth are in data/, and the generated documents are rebuilt from them by scripts/.
- Research sessions are dated snapshots (November "202 to November 2026): check research/ERRATA.md and each claim's date before relying on a figure.
- Rules for agents that edit or answer from this repository are in AGENTS.md.

## Start here

- [Start Here: Navigate a GenAI Career](career/README.md): Entry point to the career content: start from your situation or your question, see the map of GenAI roles, follow the lifecycle stages, or take the path for your background. Every page links back to graded evidence.
- [Research Layer: Sessions, Findings, Decisions and Errata](research/README.md): Index of the evidence layer: 75 research sessions (22 Phase 0, 2 Phase 3, 51 RP2), the findings registry distilled from them, the decision registry, the Founding Architecture Document, errata and how to add research.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): What is covered, what is planned next, and the open decisions.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Rules for AI agents: sources of truth, evidence standard, generators and validation.

## Stage 00: Start-here tools

- [Stage 00: Start-here tools](career/00-start/README.md): Index of stage 00 (start-here tools): the workbook, glossary and 291-tool catalog that help at every stage of a GenAI career search, plus a personal script that turns your skill ratings into a gap report.
- [Glossary: Terms, Codes and Acronyms Used in This Repository](career/00-start/glossary.md): Plain one-line definitions of the evidence codes, role and skill terms, and the hiring, pay, India, visa and governance vocabulary used across the repository, each linked to a page that uses it, so a newcomer or an AI agent can read any page.
- [Targeting Workbook: From Point Zero to a Ranked Target List and a 90-Day Plan](career/00-start/targeting-workbook.md): Step-by-step workbook from point zero to a ranked target list: score readiness on 12 skills, set constraints and a pay floor against measured anchors across nine routes, place targets in three rings, and write a 90-day plan judged by gate G1.
- [Career Tool Catalog: What to Use, Use With Care, Avoid or Watch](career/00-start/tool-catalog.md): 291 external career tools and platforms across the lifecycle, each with a verdict (use, use with care, avoid, watch), the evidence behind it, its source and the date it was checked.

## Stage 01: Landscape

- [Stage 01: Landscape](career/01-landscape/README.md): Index of stage 01 (landscape): What does the GenAI job market look like, globally and in India, and which employers are hiring?
- [Emerging GenAI Roles: How to Read a New Job Title](career/01-landscape/emerging-roles.md): How to read a new GenAI job title (a real role, a skill inside an existing role, or unproven hype): the seven graduation tests in plain words, a dated watchlist of emerging, candidate and quarantined titles updated through November 2026, what would change each status, and how to use emerging terms honestly on a résumé.
- [The GenAI Employer Landscape: Six Employer Types and How Each Hires, Interviews, Pays and Onboards](career/01-landscape/employer-landscape.md): One employer taxonomy for the GenAI job market as of November 2026: six types mapped to ATS patterns, sponsor registers, remote and India presence, interview loops, pay, onboarding and credentials, paired with the target-employers directory.
- [GenAI Career Hype Register: Circulating Claims Checked Against Evidence](career/01-landscape/hype-register.md): Decision D-012 Hype Register: 19 boom and doom claims about GenAI careers that the research sessions traced, tested or corrected, each with its origin, the measured evidence and a decision rule.
- [The GenAI Job Market in November 2026: What It Looks Like and What It Means for You](career/01-landscape/market-overview.md): What the GenAI job market looks like as of November 2026, globally and in India: which titles have measured volume, where demand, layoffs, funding, pay pressure and applicant competition sit, what is short and what is commoditised, and the decision rules that follow for each kind of job seeker.
- [Target GenAI Employers Directory: ATS Boards, Sponsorship Registers and India Presence](career/01-landscape/target-employers.md): 95 vetted GenAI target employers grouped by employer type with ATS platforms, public board URLs, sponsorship evidence, India presence and 7 official sponsor registers.

## Stage 02: Roles

- [Stage 02: Roles](career/02-roles/README.md): Index of stage 02 (roles): Which GenAI roles exist, which are the best, and which should I target?
- [Role Hubs: One Page per Role](career/02-roles/hubs/README.md): Index of the 29 role hubs: one generated page per canonical role with its definition, footprint, graded scores, skills, proof, interview track and résumé pointers.
- [GenAI Target Roles: The Sorted Shortlist](career/02-roles/genai-target-roles.md): Which GenAI roles to target, in order: a sorted shortlist from a consensus of eight lenses restricted to GenAI demand, with the tier rules, one line per role, and a method for choosing one cluster, its top title and two adjacent titles.
- [GenAI Role Master Catalog](career/02-roles/role-catalog.md): All 29 canonical GenAI roles and 418 classified job titles: role profiles, evidence status and volumes, aliases, the quarantine register of speculative titles, and an A-Z title index.
- [The GenAI Role Map: Where the Work Sits](career/02-roles/role-map.md): Where each GenAI role's work sits: six stack layers from compute to applications, four cross-cutting planes, every role's footprint, the specialisations inside roles, and how to choose a direction. A map, not a pay model.
- [Role Rankings: The Composite Career Index (All Demand)](career/02-roles/role-rankings.md): Evidence-weighted ranking of the GenAI roles on all demand for each title (CCI): pillar scores with uncertainty ranges, Monte Carlo ranks, weight sensitivity, goal, persona and India lenses, and a dossier per role.

## Stage 03: Skills and technology

- [Stage 03: Skills and technology](career/03-skills-and-tech/README.md): Index of stage 03 (skills and technology): What exactly does each role need me to know and use, and how much does each skill matter?
- [Agentic Protocols: MCP, A2A and AG-UI at the Depth Your Role Needs](career/03-skills-and-tech/agentic-protocols.md): What MCP, A2A and AG-UI are and their dated status through November 2026, what to know at each depth (awareness, build, operate) for your role, how employers ask for protocol skills, the security essentials, and how to prove the skill.
- [Rated GenAI Learning Resources Catalogue: Courses, Docs, Books and Paid Programmes](career/03-skills-and-tech/learning-resources.md): 60 sceptically rated GenAI learning resources (52 from T0-68 plus 8 primary technical specifications) mapped to all 12 role families with rubric scores, refund checks, COI flags and hard gates.
- [Learning Roadmaps: What to Learn, in What Order, Resources Rated, and How Long It Takes](career/03-skills-and-tech/learning-roadmaps.md): How to learn what a target GenAI role needs: sequencing by family and background, sceptically rated free and paid resources, compute budgets, staleness traps, and the four gates that prove progress.
- [GenAI Role Skill Inventories](career/03-skills-and-tech/role-skill-inventories.md): Index of the complete typed skill inventory per role, with cross-role views for universal and family resumes, the tier decisions, verification, and the requirements and tier rule behind the skills ontology.
- [Role Skill Maps](career/03-skills-and-tech/role-skill-maps.md): Narrative skill map for every role: practice notes from the evidence, tools in use with their November 2026 status, proof of work, interview track, typical gaps and entry routes. Each role's skills and tiers are in its generated inventory.
- [GenAI Skills Radar: Learn First, Differentiate, Specialise, Replace](career/03-skills-and-tech/skills-radar.md): What to learn first, what sets each résumé family apart, which skills only one or two roles demand, what to stop investing in, and multi-signal adoption momentum, built from the skills ontology for the 24 IC roles.
- [GenAI Skills Vocabulary](career/03-skills-and-tech/skills-vocabulary.md): Every skill in the ontology, typed (concept, method, language, framework, tool, platform, non-technical), with posting wording, relations, alternatives, status and corpus mentions.

## Stage 04: Certifications

- [Credential ROI: Whether a Certificate Is Worth It, Which One, and How to Show It](career/04-certifications/credential-roi.md): Whether a certificate is worth it for your target role and hiring channel, access gates, Waves 1–6 sequencing and Decision Gates G0–G4, voucher arbitrage, per-issuer deep dives across 194 vetted credentials, how to show one and when to stop.
- [Credentials by Role](career/04-certifications/credentials-by-role.md): Which certifications the evidence lists for each GenAI role, at which tier, and each credential's dated status, generated from the skills ontology.

- [Proof-of-Work Standards: What a GenAI Portfolio Must Show to Be Believed](career/05-portfolio/proof-of-work-standards.md): What a GenAI portfolio must show to be believed at your target level: the verifiability ladder (V0–V3), the 15 artefacts by tier, nine anti-portfolio patterns, open-source employer-domain commit map, the public micro-audit operating system with legal guardrails and break-even effort math, and demo hardening.

## Stage 06: Job search

- [Stage 06: Job search and applications](career/06-job-search/README.md): Index of stage 06 (job search and applications): How do I find postings, apply well and get past the screens?
- [Application Operating System: Tracker, Weekly Rhythm, Tooling Stack, Funnel Metrics and When to Change Course](career/06-job-search/application-operating-system.md): A weekly operating system for running a job search: tracker fields (D-022 generic scope), weekly rhythm, graded funnel metrics and thresholds, plus a T0-26 security and terms-of-service guide to trackers, autofill, auto-apply agents, open-source tools and MCP servers.
- [ATS Mechanics and AI-Mediated Hiring: Screening, AI Interviewers, Integrity Checks and Legal Pointers](career/06-job-search/ats-mechanics.md): How applicant tracking systems, AI screening layers, employer-run AI interviewers and proctoring or identity checks work, plus rules for parse-safe résumés, knockout answers, fraud defence and dated legal pointers.
- [Channels and Boards: Where GenAI Postings Are and Which Channels Convert](career/06-job-search/channels-and-boards.md): Where GenAI postings appear globally, in India and across regional markets, which entry channels convert, how to search employer ATS boards, pay-transparency and ghost-job law status, and scam and malware checks.
- [GenAI Job-Search Strategy: Hiring Levers, Binding Constraints, Sequencing and Target-Employer Routing](career/06-job-search/job-search-strategy.md): First-principles job-search strategy: the four levers that turn an application into an offer, the constraints that bind first, expanding-ring role sequencing, and the T0-27 target-employer methodology (50–100 company tiering, ATS detection, sponsor-register screening and scraping hygiene).
- [GenAI Resume Skills Matrix](career/06-job-search/resume-skills-matrix.md): The concise skills section for every role (Must / Important / Should / Optional headline skills), shared skills across roles, and a skills-section blueprint per resume variant.
- [GenAI Résumé Strategy: One Master Inventory, Layered Résumés, Light Tailoring](career/06-job-search/resume-strategy.md): How to run résumés for many GenAI roles: one private master inventory, one universal résumé, two or three variants from a catalogue of 15, light tailoring per posting, seniority and regional norms, and the computed role-résumé decisions.

## Stage 07: Networking

- [Stage 07: Networking and visibility](career/07-networking/README.md): Index of stage 07 (networking and visibility): How do I get referred, get found by recruiters, join the right communities or fellowships, and present checkable public proof?
- [Communities Guide: AI Communities, X Strategy, Events, Competitions and Safety](career/07-networking/communities-guide.md): Which AI communities, social platforms, events and competitions are worth weekly hours, how to participate without triggering spam or malware risks, and how India-based engineers gain global visibility.
- [Fellowships, Residencies and Open-Source Mentorships: Eligibility, Visas, Stipends and Outcomes](career/07-networking/fellowships-and-residencies.md): Evidence-graded directory of 17 AI fellowships, residencies and open-source mentorships: work-authorisation gates, visa support, stipends, COI-flagged outcomes, preparation and stale-page traps.
- [LinkedIn Guide: Recruiter Search, Profile Mechanics, Content and Paid Tiers](career/07-networking/linkedin-guide.md): How LinkedIn Recruiter search, Hiring Assistant 2, Open to Work, verification, Easy Apply, feed ranking and Premium Career work for GenAI job seekers, separating documented mechanics from folklore.
- [Online Presence: GitHub, Portfolio Sites, Technical Writing and LinkedIn](career/07-networking/online-presence.md): How to make GitHub, a portfolio site, technical writing and LinkedIn checkable in minutes, calibrated to your role family and employer type, with verified platform rules and honest limits.
- [Referrals and Outreach: Vouched Ties, Cold Notes, Outreach Law and Open Source](career/07-networking/referrals-and-outreach.md): How to earn vouched referrals, run double opt-in introductions, write compliant artefact-led cold notes across seven jurisdictions, avoid recruiter scams and decide when open source pays off.

## Stage 08: Interviewing

- [Stage 08: Interviewing](career/08-interviewing/README.md): Index of stage 08 (interviewing): How do I pass the interview loop for my track?
- [Behavioural Calibration: How GenAI Behavioural Rounds Are Scored and How to Build a Story Bank](career/08-interviewing/behavioral-calibration.md): How behavioural rounds are scored across GenAI employers, the four competencies C1–C4, employer committee and veto/downlevel calibration, and how to build a STAR-AI story bank.
- [Coding Rounds in GenAI Loops: Classic, AI-Enabled, Document Review, Debugging and Integrity](career/08-interviewing/coding-rounds.md): Coding-round formats in GenAI loops (classic and library-free, AI-enabled, design-document review and p95 latency debugging), employer AI-coding policies, platform proctoring and anti-cheat reality, and a practice ladder.
- [Employer Interview Loops: 61 Employers, AI Policies, Take-Homes, In-Person Rules and Timelines](career/08-interviewing/employer-interview-loops.md): Per-employer interview loops across 61 frontier labs, Big Tech, AI-native startups, inference clouds, safety and robotics labs, banks, consultancies, India/IT-services firms and expert platforms, with AI policies, take-homes and timelines.
- [Interview Loops: Classify Your GenAI Loop, Prepare Each Round, Run the Day and Follow Up](career/08-interviewing/interview-loops.md): How GenAI interview loops are structured across 61 employers, how to classify yours before preparing, what each round tests, AI-assistant and in-person policies, take-homes, debriefs and recruiter templates.
- [Interview Prep Packs: Practice Prompts by Track](career/08-interviewing/prep-packs.md): 161 practice prompts for the GenAI interview tracks, each with what a strong answer covers, the red flags interviewers note, the roles it applies to and its source; plus the 15 system-design archetypes.
- [GenAI System-Design Interviews: 15 Archetypes, the 45-Minute Blueprint, the Numbers and the Rubrics](career/08-interviewing/system-design-archetypes.md): How to prepare for and run a GenAI system-design round: classify the loop, drill the right archetypes out of 15, run the 45-minute blueprint, compute the numbers with dated multi-vendor API prices, and meet the evaluation, safety and Staff-level rubrics.

## Stage 09: Compensation

- [Stage 09: Compensation and negotiation](career/09-compensation/README.md): Index of stage 09 (compensation and negotiation): Is this offer good, and how do I negotiate it?
- [India Remote Tax: Structure, Thresholds and Traps for Engineers Paid by Foreign Clients](career/09-compensation/india-remote-tax.md): For India-based engineers paid directly by US, EU or UK clients: which structure fits which billing level, the ₹75 lakh presumptive-tax cliff (Income-tax Act 2025 s.58), GST and LUT, FEMA 2026 EDF reporting, PA-CB rails, client forms and the EOR trade-off, as dated pointers rather than tax advice.
- [Negotiation Playbook: Phases, Scripts, Levers and Counter-Moves for a GenAI Offer](career/09-compensation/negotiation-playbook.md): How to negotiate a GenAI offer in six phases: fill-in scripts for expectations, counters, competing offers, deadlines and India CTC breakdowns; the 13 levers; if-then replies; and regional playbooks for the US, India, UK, Europe and beyond.
- [Offer Evaluation: Valuing Cash, Liquid Equity and Paper Equity Before You Sign](career/09-compensation/offer-evaluation.md): How to put GenAI offers on one cash-equivalent basis (base, bonus, liquid equity, locked IPO equity and discounted paper equity, plus India CTC and ESOP mechanics), decide whether moving beats staying, and run equity due diligence.
- [Pay Benchmarks: What GenAI Roles Pay by Title, City, Level and Employer](career/09-compensation/pay-benchmarks.md): Measured pay for GenAI roles by title, city, level and employer type across the US, India, UK, Europe, Canada, Israel, Singapore, the Gulf, Japan and Australia as of November 2026, with source, date and grade on every row.

## Stage 10: Onboarding

- [Stage 10: Onboarding and the first 90 days](career/10-onboarding/README.md): Index of stage 10 (onboarding and the first 90 days): How do I pass probation, navigate AI-tool expectations and sustain career growth?
- [First 90 Days: Close the Expectations Gap and Pass Probation in a GenAI Role](career/10-onboarding/first-90-days.md): How to pass probation in a GenAI role: score the expectations gap in weeks 1–2, navigate US/UK/EU/India probation rules, ship the 13 weekly artefacts of a 30-60-90 plan, confirm a scorecard by day 14, report variance and shipped outcomes upward, and escalate by written rules.
- [Growth and Progression: Promotion, Moving On, IC or Manager, Burnout and Sustainable Pace](career/10-onboarding/growth-and-progression.md): After the first 90 days: how promotion and levelling pay in GenAI careers, when a move beats staying, navigating thinning management tracks and Staff+ inflection, avoiding the 10x AI-productivity trap, and managing burnout and sustainable pace.

## Stage 11: Tracks and transitions

- [Stage 11: Tracks and transitions](career/11-tracks/README.md): Index of stage 11 (tracks and transitions): What changes for my background, location or way of working?
- [Regional Visa Dossiers](career/11-tracks/visa/README.md): Index of the six regional visa dossiers covering 31 countries across North America, Europe, the Gulf, Israel, and Asia-Pacific, anchored to the central V0 status table.
- [Career Transitions into GenAI: Roadmaps from Nine Starting Backgrounds](career/11-tracks/career-transitions.md): Roadmaps into GenAI from nine starting backgrounds (including DevOps/SRE, product managers, India IT-services engineers and students): what transfers, traps, modelled timelines and gates G1–G4.
- [GenAI Country and City Rankings](career/11-tracks/country-rankings.md): Monte Carlo rankings of 33 GenAI destination countries and 51 city snapshots across 7 decision lenses, generated from data/countries.json (T0-35, T0-36, T0-37–T0-43, T0-67).
- [Freelance, Fractional and Contract AI Work: Rates, Income Reality, Clients, Contracts and Expert Platforms](career/11-tracks/freelance-fractional.md): Whether to go independent as an AI consultant, fractional AI leader or expert-data contractor: dated rates and modelled income, viability gates, network-first client acquisition, contracts and IP defaults, expert-platform reality, and stop rules.
- [Governance Careers: Entering AI Governance, Risk and Assurance](career/11-tracks/governance-careers.md): Entering AI governance, risk and assurance from GRC, privacy, audit, legal, security or ML engineering: the career families regulation has created, their real volumes, entry routes by background, and the proof and credentials worth having.
- [India Remote Playbook: Routes from India to US and EU Work](career/11-tracks/india-remote-playbook.md): For India-based engineers who want US or EU work: how to choose between a GCC job, remote employment through an EOR, direct contracting and relocation, how India's six tech hubs compare, what each route pays, and what to set up before the first offer or invoice.
- [PhD to Industry: Research and Applied Routes into GenAI](career/11-tracks/phd-to-industry.md): For PhDs and academic researchers moving into GenAI: which role to target, the engineering gap that decides offers, an 8-week skills block, fellowships, modelled timelines, and how a research record maps to O-1A evidence.
- [Cross-Border Remote Work for GenAI Roles](career/11-tracks/remote-cross-border.md): Evidence-graded guide to finding, pricing and structuring cross-border remote GenAI roles across direct contracting, Contractor of Record, Employer of Record and local entities (T0-43).
- [Visa and Relocation: Global Talent-Visa Corridors for AI Professionals](career/11-tracks/visa-and-relocation.md): Global visa corridor comparison across 31 countries in six regions for GenAI professionals, with Indian-national depth, the central V0 contested-rule status table, and the O-1A / UK Global Talent evidence playbook. Not legal advice.
- [Visa Dossier: Asia-Pacific](career/11-tracks/visa/asia-pacific.md): Evidence-graded visa dossier for Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Australia, New Zealand, and Malaysia as of 19 November 2026, including Jan 2027 Singapore changes and verified AU/NZ floors.
- [Visa Dossier: Canada](career/11-tracks/visa/canada.md): Evidence-graded Canada work-permit and permanent-residence dossier for GenAI practitioners as of 19 November 2026, covering GTS, the November 2026 Express Entry CRS overhaul, provincial closures, and the Start-Up Visa pause.
- [Visa Dossier: Gulf States & Israel](career/11-tracks/visa/gulf-and-israel.md): Evidence-graded visa dossier for the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, and Israel as of 19 November 2026, covering Golden Visa salary disputes, Saudi Premium Residency, Israel B/1 Hi-Tech, and attestation traps.
- [Visa Dossier: Nordics, Southern & Central Europe](career/11-tracks/visa/nordics-southern-central-europe.md): Evidence-graded visa dossier for 10 Nordic, Southern, and Central European countries as of 19 November 2026, covering 2026 salary thresholds, digital-nomad routes, EU directives, and Indian bilateral coverage.
- [Visa Dossier: UK, Ireland & Western Europe](career/11-tracks/visa/uk-ireland-western-europe.md): Evidence-graded visa dossier for the UK, Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, France, and Switzerland as of 19 November 2026, covering 2026 salary floors, UK Earned Settlement, 2027 thresholds, and Indian-national specifics.
- [Visa Dossier: United States](career/11-tracks/visa/united-states.md): Evidence-graded US work-visa and green-card dossier for GenAI practitioners as of 19 November 2026, covering wage-weighted H-1B, O-1A, L-1, PERM, Visa Bulletin queues, and active litigation.

## Research

- [Research Findings Registry](research/findings.md): Every key finding of the 75 research sessions, with its evidence grade and exact line, grouped by lifecycle stage and by session.
- [Research Errata: Known Errors in the Sealed Research Records](research/ERRATA.md): Errors and protocol-hygiene downgrades found in the sealed Phase 0, Phase 3 (T3-02) and Research Pipeline 2 (T0-19 to T0-71) records and the correct reading, with evidence. Read before relying on those files.
- [Research Pipeline 2: Targeted Sessions for Every High-Impact Element](research/pipeline-2/README.md): The second research pipeline: 53 targeted sessions on networking, résumés, job search, certifications, countries and visas, remote work, pay, interviews and every role, each designed backwards from the data and pages it feeds, with a shared protocol, verification, integration and a generated tracker.
- [research/sessions/](research/sessions/): The 75 research sessions (dated evidence reports with source ledgers).
- [research/DECISIONS.md](research/DECISIONS.md): Architecture decision registry (D-001 to D-027).

## Data

- [data/role_scores.json](data/role_scores.json): Role facts and scoring inputs: each role's definition, work footprint and interview track, and every pillar score with its [lo, mid, hi] range, evidence grade and sourced basis
- [data/skills_ontology.json](data/skills_ontology.json): The skills ontology: 540 typed skills, choose-one classes, credentials, resume variants, every role's tiered, evidence-tagged skill links and the register of devalued skills
- [data/posting_skill_shares.json](data/posting_skill_shares.json): Dated snapshots of the skills job postings name, by posting title (JobsPipe, Grade B), cited by the role links in the ontology
- [data/role_titles.json](data/role_titles.json): The A–Z index of posting titles: each title's index type and the canonical role it maps to
- [data/project_archetypes.json](data/project_archetypes.json): Proof-of-work project archetypes: the problem, build steps, evidence to publish, verifiability target, interview archetypes, pitfalls and the skills each one evidences
- [data/interview_prompts.json](data/interview_prompts.json): Interview practice prompts keyed to interview tracks, system-design archetypes, roles and skills, with what a strong answer covers
- [data/tools.json](data/tools.json): External career tools and platforms by stage, with a verdict, evidence grade, source and date
- [data/stack_model.json](data/stack_model.json): The stack map: six layers, four cross-cutting planes, the skill-category map and the specialisations inside roles (decision D-015)
- [data/findings.json](data/findings.json): Key findings of every research session, with grade, exact line and lifecycle stages
- [data/manifest.json](data/manifest.json): This manifest: every document with its front matter and section headings
- [data/schemas/](data/schemas/): JSON Schemas for the data files and for document front matter

## Project documents

- [README.md](README.md): What the repository is, who it is for, how it is organised and its status
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): How to add or change content: placement, front matter, the writing standard (EGP-1.0 in brief), the guide pattern, generators and releases
- [CHARTER.md](CHARTER.md): Vision, scope and what the repository is not, audience, success criteria and constraints
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release history
